verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents built-in on-device acceleration, such as running on the Snapdragon Hexagon NPU and using 'whatever silicon the device has'. Nothing in the evidence describes a plugin mechanism for adding accelerator backends, or support for TPUs, Gaudi or similar datacenter accelerators. Built-in mobile NPU support is an adjacent feature, not the plugin-based accelerator extensibility the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
